operative_clauses.original_operative_text: SECTION 1. Delegation of Functions. The following functions conferred upon the President by the Arms Export Control Act (22 U.S.C. 2751 et seq.), hereinafter referred to as the Act, are delegated as follows:

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 241430; common-crawl capture 2025-11-08T22:57:34Z; Sec. 1 (lead-in)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (a) Those under Section 3 of the Act, with the exception of subsections (a) (1), (b), (c) (3) and (c) (4), to the Secretary of State: Provided) That the Secretary of State, in the implementation of the functions delegated to him under Sections 3 (a) and (d) of the Act, is authorized to find, in the case of a proposed transfer of a defense article or related training or other defense service by a foreign country or international organization not otherwise eligible under Section 3 (a) (1) of the Act, whether the proposed transfer will strengthen the security of the United States and promote world peace.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 241430; common-crawl capture 2025-11-08T22:57:34Z; Sec. 1(a)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (b) Those under Section 5 to the Secretary of State.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 241430; common-crawl capture 2025-11-08T22:57:34Z; Sec. 1(b)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (c) Those under Section 21 of the Act, with the exception of the last sentence of subsection (d) and all of subsection (h), to the Secretary of Defense.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 241430; common-crawl capture 2025-11-08T22:57:34Z; Sec. 1(c)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (d) Those under Section 22 (a) of the Act to the Secretary of Defense.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 241430; common-crawl capture 2025-11-08T22:57:34Z; Sec. 1(d)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (e) Those under Section 23 of the Act, with the exception of the function of certifying a rate of interest to the Congress as provided by paragraph (2) of that Section, to the Secretary of Defense.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 241430; common-crawl capture 2025-11-08T22:57:34Z; Sec. 1(e)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (f) Those under Section 24 of the Act to the Secretary of Defense.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 241430; common-crawl capture 2025-11-08T22:57:34Z; Sec. 1(f)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (g) Those under Section 25 of the Act to the Secretary of State. The Secretary of Defense and the Director of the Arms Control and Disarmament Agency, within their respective areas of responsibility, shall assist the Secretary of State in the preparation of materials for presentation to the Congress under that Section.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 241430; common-crawl capture 2025-11-08T22:57:34Z; Sec. 1(g)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (h) Those under Section 34 of the Act to the Secretary of State. To the extent the standards and criteria for credit and guaranty transactions are based upon national security and financial policies, the Secretary of State shall obtain the prior concurrence of the Secretary of Defense and the Secretary of the Treasury, respectively.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 241430; common-crawl capture 2025-11-08T22:57:34Z; Sec. 1(h)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (i) Those under Section 35 (a) of the Act to the Secretary of State.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 241430; common-crawl capture 2025-11-08T22:57:34Z; Sec. 1(i)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (j) Those under Sections 36 (a) and 36 (b) (1) of the Act, except with respect to the certification of an emergency as provided by subsection (b) (1), to the Secretary of Defense. The Secretary of Defense, in the implementation of the functions delegated to him under Sections 36 (a) and (b) (1) shall consult with the Secretary of State, who shall, with respect to matters related to subparagraphs (D) and (I) of Section 36 (b) (1), consult with the Director of the Arms Control and Disarmament Agency. With respect to those functions under Section 36 (a) (5) and (6), the Secretary of Defense shall consult with the Director of the Office of Management and Budget.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 241430; common-crawl capture 2025-11-08T22:57:34Z; Sec. 1(j)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (k) Those under Sections 36 (c) and (d) of the Act to the Secretary of State.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 241430; common-crawl capture 2025-11-08T22:57:34Z; Sec. 1(k)
American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 241430; common-crawl capture 2025-11-08T22:57:34Z; Sec. 1(l)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (m) Those under Section 39 (b) of the Act to the Secretary of State. In carrying out such functions, the Secretary of State shall consult with the Secretary of Defense as may be necessary to avoid interference in the application of Department of Defense regulations to sales made under Section 22 of the Act.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 241430; common-crawl capture 2025-11-08T22:57:34Z; Sec. 1(m)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (n) Those under Sections 42 (c) and (f) of the Act to the Secretary of Defense.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 241430; common-crawl capture 2025-11-08T22:57:34Z; Sec. 1(n)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (a) In addition to the specific provisions of Section 1 of this Order, the Secretary of State and the Secretary of Defense, in carrying out the functions delegated to them under this Order, shall consult with each other and with the heads of other departments and agencies, including the Secretary of the Treasury, the Administrator of the Agency for International Development and the Director of the Arms Control and Disarmament Agency, on matters pertaining to their responsibilities.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 241430; common-crawl capture 2025-11-08T22:57:34Z; Sec. 2(a)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: (b) In accordance with Section 2 (b) of the Act and under the directions of the President, the Secretary of State, taking into account other United States activities abroad, shall be responsible for the continuous supervision and general direction of sales and exports under the Act, including but not limited to, the negotiation, conclusion, and termination of international agreements, and determining whether there shall be a sale to a country and the amount thereof, and whether there shall be delivery or other performance under such sale or export, to the end that sales and exports are integrated with other United States activities and the foreign policy of the United States is best served thereby.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 241430; common-crawl capture 2025-11-08T22:57:34Z; Sec. 2(b)

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: SEC. 3. Allocation of Funds. Funds appropriated to the President for carrying out the Act shall be deemed to be allocated to the Secretary of Defense without any further action of the President.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 241430; common-crawl capture 2025-11-08T22:57:34Z; Sec. 3

operative_clauses.original_operative_text: SEC. 4. Revocation. Executive Order No. 11501, as amended, is revoked; except that, to the extent consistent with this Order, all determinations, authorizations, regulations, rulings, certificates, orders, directives, contracts, agreements, and other actions made, issued, taken or entered into under the provisions of Executive Order No. 11501, as amended, and not revoked, superseded or otherwise made inapplicable, shall continue in full force and effect until amended, modified or terminated by appropriate authority.

original_source.page_or_item: American Presidency Project web page (transcription; not an official edition); APP node 241430; common-crawl capture 2025-11-08T22:57:34Z; Sec. 4
